# pyas-connect



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

PyasConnect 2.0: the dialog a developer's users connect a calendar in
(plan §59; screens and copy in the PyasConnect 2.0 Design doc).

  <pyas-connect session-token="pcs_..."></pyas-connect>

## Events

| Event              | Description                                                        | Type                                                                                                    |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `accountConnected` | 1.x: as `connected`.                                               | `CustomEvent<any>`                                                                                      |
| `cancel`           | The person closed it without connecting.                           | `CustomEvent<void>`                                                                                     |
| `connected`        | A calendar was connected.                                          | `CustomEvent<{ accountId: string; provider: string; email: string; name: string; subjectId: string; }>` |
| `connectError`     | 1.x: as `error`.                                                   | `CustomEvent<{ message: string; code: string; }>`                                                       |
| `error`            | The flow ended without connecting: `code`, `message`, `retryable`. | `CustomEvent<ConnectErrorInfo>`                                                                         |


## Methods

### `close() => Promise<void>`

Closes the dialog, reporting how it ended.

#### Returns

Type: `Promise<void>`



### `open() => Promise<void>`

Opens the dialog. Call it from a click (a sign-in window may only open from one).

#### Returns

Type: `Promise<void>`
